184760.35) <= 0.01\n    )\n\n    document = Document(recommendation_path)\n    recommendation_text = \"\\n\".join(paragraph.text for paragraph in document.paragraphs)\n    recommendation_ok = all(\n        phrase in recommendation_text\n        for phrase in (\"GLGS-UPS-07\", \"$184,760.35 per hour\", \"Tier 1\", \"Q2 2026\")\n    )\n\n    if register_ok and recommendation_ok:\n        return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Controlled asset and procurement sources remain intact\"}\n    return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"Controlled source values no longer match the approved record\"}\n",
